author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
What are some of Adam Savage's memories of Jamie giddiness on MythBusters? How would Adam approach making a jacket with protective qualities or a template for a vinyl wrap? And has Adam ever considered making the Schufftein glasses from The Golden Army? In this live stream excerpt Adam answers these questions from Tested members phlowtey, murdawglles17, coMOTose and makingtolearn, whom we thank for their support!
